mapper.select: SELECT e.*, a.code AS account_code, a.name AS account_name, d.name AS dept_name, p.name AS project_name, c.name AS customer_name, s.name AS supplier_name, m.name AS material_name FROM fin_voucher_entry e JOIN fin_account a ON a.id = e.account_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.id = e.dept_id LEFT JOIN pm_project p ON p.id = e.project_id LEFT JOIN scm_customer c ON c.id = e.customer_id LEFT JOIN scm_supplier s ON s.id = e.supplier_id LEFT JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = e.material_id WHERE e.voucher_id = #{voucherId} ORDER BY e.seq
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO fin_voucher_entry (voucher_id, seq, summary, account_id, dept_id, project_id, customer_id, supplier_id, material_id, debit, credit, create_time, update_time) VALUES
(#{i.voucherId}, #{i.seq}, #{i.summary}, #{i.accountId}, #{i.deptId}, #{i.projectId}, #{i.customerId}, #{i.supplierId}, #{i.materialId}, #{i.debit}, #{i.credit}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT e.account_id, v.period, e.dept_id, SUM(e.debit) AS debit, SUM(e.credit) AS credit FROM fin_voucher_entry e JOIN fin_voucher v ON v.id = e.voucher_id WHERE v.status = 'POSTED' AND v.source_type <> 'CLOSE' AND v.period >= #{begin} AND v.period <= #{end} AND e.account_id IN #{id} GROUP BY e.account_id, v.period, e.dept_id

SELECT v.voucher_date AS entry_date, v.id AS voucher_id, v.voucher_no, e.summary, a.code AS account_code, a.name AS account_name, e.debit, e.credit FROM fin_voucher_entry e JOIN fin_voucher v ON v.id = e.voucher_id JOIN fin_account a ON a.id = e.account_id WHERE v.status = 'POSTED' AND v.period >= #{begin} AND v.period <= #{end} AND e.account_id IN #{id} ORDER BY v.voucher_date, v.period, v.voucher_seq, e.seq

SELECT t.aux_id, NULLx.code AS aux_code, x.name AS aux_name, a.id AS account_id, a.code AS account_code, a.name AS account_name, t.debit, t.credit, t.balance FROM ( SELECT AS aux_id, e.account_id, SUM(CASE WHEN v.period >= #{begin} THEN e.debit ELSE 0 END) AS debit, SUM(CASE WHEN v.period >= #{begin} THEN e.credit ELSE 0 END) AS credit, SUM(e.debit - e.credit) AS balance FROM fin_voucher_entry e JOIN fin_voucher v ON v.id = e.voucher_id WHERE v.status = 'POSTED' AND v.period <= #{end} AND IS NOT NULL AND e.account_id = #{accountId} GROUP BY , e.account_id ) t JOIN fin_account a ON a.id = t.account_id
LEFT JOIN sys_dept x ON x.id = t.aux_id LEFT JOIN scm_customer x ON x.id = t.aux_id LEFT JOIN scm_supplier x ON x.id = t.aux_id LEFT JOIN pm_project x ON x.id = t.aux_id LEFT JOIN wms_material x ON x.id = t.aux_id
WHERE t.debit <> 0 OR t.credit <> 0 OR t.balance <> 0 ORDER BY x.namex.code, a.code
